## src/main/java/kr/ac/yumin/playlist/service/MelonChartService.java

```java
package kr.ac.yumin.playlist.service;

import kr.ac.yumin.playlist.config.Database;
import kr.ac.yumin.playlist.dao.Jdbc;

import org.jsoup.Jsoup;
import org.jsoup.nodes.*;

import java.nio.file.*;
import java.sql.*;
import java.time.*;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.regex.*;

/** Public chart metadata only. No streaming URLs or audio are collected. */
public final class MelonChartService {
    public static final String SOURCE = "https://www.melon.com/chart/index.htm";

    public record Artist(long id, String name) {}

    public record Entry(
            int rank,
            long melonId,
            String title,
            String album,
            String cover,
            List<Artist> artists) {
        public long songId() {
            return 1_000_000_000L + melonId;
        }
    }

    public record Snapshot(LocalDateTime chartAt, List<Entry> entries) {}

    public Snapshot fetch() throws Exception {
        return parse(
                Jsoup.connect(SOURCE)
                        .userAgent("Mozilla/5.0")
                        .referrer("https://www.melon.com/")
                        .timeout(30000)
                        .get());
    }

    public Snapshot read(Path path) throws Exception {
        return parse(Jsoup.parse(path.toFile(), "UTF-8", SOURCE));
    }

    public Snapshot parse(Document document) {
        try {
            LocalDateTime at =
                    LocalDateTime.parse(
                            document.selectFirst(".year").text()
                                    + " "
                                    + document.selectFirst(".hour").text(),
                            DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyy.MM.dd HH:mm"));
            List<Entry> entries = new ArrayList<>();
            Set<Long> songs = new HashSet<>();
            for (Element row : document.select("tr.lst50[data-song-no], tr.lst100[data-song-no]")) {
                int rank = Integer.parseInt(row.selectFirst(".rank").text());
                long id = Long.parseLong(row.attr("data-song-no"));
                String title = row.selectFirst(".rank01 a").text();
                String album = row.selectFirst(".rank03 a").text();
                Map<Long, Artist> artists = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                for (Element a : row.select(".rank02 a[href*=artistId]")) {
                    Matcher matcher =
                            Pattern.compile("artistId[=\\s]*([0-9]+)").matcher(a.attr("href"));
                    if (matcher.find()) {
                        long artistId = Long.parseLong(matcher.group(1));
                        artists.putIfAbsent(
                                artistId, new Artist(2_000_000_000L + artistId, a.text()));
                    }
                }
                if (rank != entries.size() + 1
                        || !songs.add(id)
                        || title.isBlank()
                        || album.isBlank()
                        || artists.isEmpty())
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("차트 순위·중복·곡 정보 검증 실패");
                entries.add(
                        new Entry(
                                rank,
                                id,
                                title,
                                album,
                                row.selectFirst("img").absUrl("src"),
                                List.copyOf(artists.values())));
            }
            if (entries.size() != 100) throw new IllegalArgumentException("TOP100 전체 100곡이 필요합니다.");
            return new Snapshot(at, List.copyOf(entries));
        } catch (RuntimeException e) {
            throw new AppException("멜론 차트 형식이 바뀌었거나 100곡을 확인할 수 없습니다. 기존 DB 목록은 유지됩니다.");
        }
    }

    public void save(Snapshot snapshot) throws SQLException {
        if (snapshot.entries().size() != 100) throw new AppException("100곡을 확인한 차트만 저장할 수 있습니다.");
        try (Connection c = Database.open()) {
            c.setAutoCommit(false);
            try {
                Jdbc.update(c, "LOCK TABLE MELON_CHART IN EXCLUSIVE MODE WAIT 5");
                Timestamp at = Timestamp.valueOf(snapshot.chartAt());
                for (Entry e : snapshot.entries()) {
                    for (Artist a : e.artists()) {
                        Jdbc.update(
                                c,
                                "MERGE INTO ARTIST d USING(SELECT ? id FROM DUAL) x"
                                    + " ON(d.artist_id=x.id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET"
                                    + " artist_name=? WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN"
                                    + " INSERT(artist_id,artist_name,country) VALUES(x.id,?,'미확인')",
                                a.id(),
                                a.name(),
                                a.name());
                    }
                    Jdbc.update(
                            c,
                            "MERGE INTO SONG d USING(SELECT ? id FROM DUAL) x ON(d.song_id=x.id)"
                                    + " WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET title=?,album_title=? WHEN NOT"
                                    + " MATCHED THEN INSERT(song_id,title,album_title)"
                                    + " VALUES(x.id,?,?)",
                            e.songId(),
                            e.title(),
                            e.album(),
                            e.title(),
                            e.album());
                    for (Artist a : e.artists())
                        Jdbc.update(
                                c,
                                "MERGE INTO SONG_ARTIST d USING(SELECT ? s,? a FROM DUAL) x"
                                    + " ON(d.song_id=x.s AND d.artist_id=x.a) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN"
                                    + " INSERT(song_id,artist_id) VALUES(x.s,x.a)",
                                e.songId(),
                                a.id());
                }
                Jdbc.update(
                        c,
                        "MERGE INTO MELON_CHART d USING(SELECT ? at FROM DUAL) x"
                                + " ON(d.chart_at=x.at) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET"
                                + " fetched_at=SYSTIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN"
                                + " INSERT(chart_at,source_url,row_count) VALUES(x.at,?,100)",
                        at,
                        SOURCE);
                for (Entry e : snapshot.entries())
                    Jdbc.update(
                            c,
                            "MERGE INTO MELON_CHART_ENTRY d USING(SELECT ? at,? rank FROM DUAL) x"
                                + " ON(d.chart_at=x.at AND d.chart_rank=x.rank) WHEN MATCHED THEN"
                                + " UPDATE SET song_id=?,melon_song_id=?,cover_url=? WHEN NOT"
                                + " MATCHED THEN"
                                + " INSERT(chart_at,chart_rank,song_id,melon_song_id,cover_url)"
                                + " VALUES(x.at,x.rank,?,?,?)",
                            at,
                            e.rank(),
                            e.songId(),
                            e.melonId(),
                            e.cover(),
                            e.songId(),
                            e.melonId(),
                            e.cover());
                c.commit();
            } catch (Exception e) {
                c.rollback();
                throw e;
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        MelonChartService service = new MelonChartService();
        Snapshot snapshot = args.length == 0 ? service.fetch() : service.read(Path.of(args[0]));
        service.save(snapshot);
        System.out.println(
                "Oracle Melon TOP100: "
                        + snapshot.chartAt()
                        + " / "
                        + snapshot.entries().size()
                        + " songs");
    }
}
```

## src/main/java/kr/ac/yumin/playlist/service/MembershipService.java

```java
package kr.ac.yumin.playlist.service;

import kr.ac.yumin.playlist.config.Database;
import kr.ac.yumin.playlist.dao.Jdbc;
import kr.ac.yumin.playlist.model.*;

import java.sql.*;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.*;

/** 실청구가 없는 과제용 결제. 상태의 원본은 Oracle이며 파일에 유료 상태를 저장하지 않는다. */
public final class MembershipService {
    public static final int PRICE_WON = 4900;
    private final String member;

    public MembershipService(Member member) {
        this.member = member.id();
    }

    public PassStatus status() throws SQLException {
        try (Connection c = Database.open()) {
            return status(c);
        }
    }

    private PassStatus status(Connection c) throws SQLException {
        return Jdbc.list(
                        c,
                        """
SELECT (SELECT MAX(valid_until) FROM MEMBERSHIP_ORDER WHERE member_id=? AND status='PAID'),
CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) FROM DUAL
""",
                        r ->
                                new PassStatus(
                                        r.getTimestamp(1) == null
                                                ? null
                                                : r.getTimestamp(1).toLocalDateTime(),
                                        r.getTimestamp(2).toLocalDateTime()),
                        member)
                .get(0);
    }

    public List<PaymentOrder> history() throws SQLException {
        try (Connection c = Database.open()) {
            return Jdbc.list(
                    c,
                    "SELECT order_id,amount_won,paid_at,valid_until,status FROM MEMBERSHIP_ORDER"
                            + " WHERE member_id=? ORDER BY paid_at DESC,order_id",
                    r ->
                            new PaymentOrder(
                                    r.getString(1),
                                    r.getInt(2),
                                    r.getTimestamp(3).toLocalDateTime(),
                                    r.getTimestamp(4).toLocalDateTime(),
                                    r.getString(5)),
                    member);
        }
    }

    public void purchase(String requestId) throws SQLException {
        UUID.fromString(requestId);
        try (Connection c = Database.open()) {
            c.setAutoCommit(false);
            try {
                lockMember(c);
                var existing =
                        Jdbc.list(
                                c,
                                "SELECT member_id FROM MEMBERSHIP_ORDER WHERE order_id=?",
                                r -> r.getString(1),
                                requestId);
                if (!existing.isEmpty()) {
                    if (!member.equals(existing.get(0)))
                        throw new AppException("다른 보관함의 결제 요청입니다.");
                    c.rollback();
                    return;
                }
                PassStatus current = status(c);
                LocalDateTime start =
                        current.active() ? current.expiresAt() : current.databaseNow();
                Jdbc.update(
                        c,
                        "INSERT INTO"
                            + " MEMBERSHIP_ORDER(order_id,member_id,amount_won,valid_until,status,payment_method)"
                            + " VALUES(?,?,?,?,'PAID','DEMO')",
                        requestId,
                        member,
                        PRICE_WON,
                        Timestamp.valueOf(start.plusDays(30)));
                c.commit();
            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException e) {
                c.rollback();
                throw e;
            }
        }
    }

    public void cancelLatest() throws SQLException {
        try (Connection c = Database.open()) {
            c.setAutoCommit(false);
            try {
                lockMember(c);
                var ids =
                        Jdbc.list(
                                c,
                                "SELECT order_id FROM MEMBERSHIP_ORDER WHERE member_id=? AND"
                                        + " status='PAID' ORDER BY valid_until DESC,paid_at DESC",
                                r -> r.getString(1),
                                member);
                if (ids.isEmpty()) throw new AppException("취소할 이용권이 없습니다.");
                Jdbc.update(
                        c,
                        "UPDATE MEMBERSHIP_ORDER SET status='CANCELLED' WHERE order_id=? AND"
                                + " member_id=? AND status='PAID'",
                        ids.get(0),
                        member);
                c.commit();
            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException e) {
                c.rollback();
                throw e;
            }
        }
    }

    private void lockMember(Connection c) throws SQLException {
        if (Jdbc.list(
                        c,
                        "SELECT member_id FROM MEMBER WHERE member_id=? FOR UPDATE WAIT 5",
                        r -> r.getString(1),
                        member)
                .isEmpty()) throw new AppException("개인 보관함을 찾을 수 없습니다.");
    }
}
```

```java
package kr.ac.yumin.playlist.service;

import kr.ac.yumin.playlist.config.Database;
import kr.ac.yumin.playlist.dao.MediaDao;
import kr.ac.yumin.playlist.model.*;

import java.sql.*;
import java.util.*;

public final class MusicLibraryService {
    private final MediaDao media = new MediaDao();
    private final MembershipService membership;

    public MusicLibraryService(Member member) {
        membership = new MembershipService(member);
    }

    public List<MediaTrack> catalog() throws SQLException {
        try (Connection c = Database.open()) {
            return media.catalog(c);
        }
    }

    public record Playback(MediaTrack track, PassStatus pass) {}

    public Playback authorize(long songId) throws SQLException {
        MediaTrack track;
        try (Connection c = Database.open()) {
            track = media.find(c, songId);
        }
        if (track == null || !track.playable())
            throw new AppException("곡 정보만 등록되어 있습니다. 재생하려면 사용 권한이 있는 MP3 음원을 연결해 주세요.");
        if (!track.resource().matches("audio/[a-z0-9-]+[.]mp3|local-audio/[a-f0-9-]+[.]mp3"))
            throw new AppException("음원 경로가 올바르지 않습니다.");
        return new Playback(track, membership.status());
    }
}
```

## src/main/java/kr/ac/yumin/playlist/service/OnlineVideoService.java

```java
package kr.ac.yumin.playlist.service;

import com.google.gson.*;

import kr.ac.yumin.playlist.config.Database;
import kr.ac.yumin.playlist.dao.Jdbc;
import kr.ac.yumin.playlist.model.OnlineVideo;

import java.net.*;
import java.net.http.*;
import java.sql.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;

public final class OnlineVideoService {
    public Map<Long, String> states() throws SQLException {
        try (Connection c = Database.open()) {
            Map<Long, String> states = new HashMap<>();
            for (var row :
                    Jdbc.list(
                            c,
                            "SELECT song_id,match_status FROM SONG_VIDEO",
                            r -> Map.entry(r.getLong(1), r.getString(2))))
                states.put(row.getKey(), row.getValue());
            return Map.copyOf(states);
        }
    }

    public OnlineVideo resolve(long songId) throws SQLException {
        try (Connection c = Database.open()) {
            return Jdbc.list(
                            c,
                            "SELECT"
                                + " song_id,youtube_video_id,youtube_title,channel_name,video_kind,search_query,match_status"
                                + " FROM SONG_VIDEO WHERE song_id=?",
                            r ->
                                    new OnlineVideo(
                                            r.getLong(1),
                                            r.getString(2),
                                            r.getString(3),
                                            r.getString(4),
                                            r.getString(5),
                                            r.getString(6),
                                            r.getString(7)),
                            songId)
                    .stream()
                    .findFirst()
                    .orElseThrow(() -> new AppException("이 곡의 온라인 재생 정보가 없습니다. 보관함을 다시 불러와 주세요."));
        }
    }

    public record Metadata(String id, String title, String author) {}

    public Metadata metadata(String id) throws Exception {
        if (id == null || !id.matches("[A-Za-z0-9_-]{11}"))
            throw new AppException("유튜브 영상 번호가 올바르지 않습니다.");
        URI uri =
                URI.create(
                        "https://www.youtube.com/oembed?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fwatch%3Fv%3D"
                                + id
                                + "&format=json");
        {
            HttpClient client =
                    HttpClient.newBuilder().connectTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(8)).build();
            var response =
                    client.send(
                            HttpRequest.newBuilder(uri)
                                    .timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(12))
                                    .GET()
                                    .build(),
                            HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString());
            if (response.statusCode() != 200)
                throw new AppException("공개 영상 정보를 확인할 수 없습니다. 앱 안에서 다른 공식 영상을 선택해 주세요.");
            JsonObject object = JsonParser.parseString(response.body()).getAsJsonObject();
            return new Metadata(
                    id, object.get("title").getAsString(), object.get("author_name").getAsString());
        }
    }

    public void save(long songId, Metadata metadata, String kind) throws SQLException {
        if (!Set.of("MV", "AUDIO", "LIVE").contains(kind)
                || !metadata.id().matches("[A-Za-z0-9_-]{11}"))
            throw new AppException("영상 정보가 올바르지 않습니다.");
        try (Connection c = Database.open()) {
            if (Jdbc.update(
                            c,
                            "UPDATE SONG_VIDEO SET"
                                + " youtube_video_id=?,youtube_title=?,channel_name=?,video_kind=?,match_status='METADATA',checked_at=SYSTIMESTAMP"
                                + " WHERE song_id=?",
                            metadata.id(),
                            metadata.title(),
                            metadata.author(),
                            kind,
                            songId)
                    != 1) throw new AppException("등록된 곡을 찾을 수 없습니다.");
        }
    }

    public void confirmed(long songId, String id) throws SQLException {
        try (Connection c = Database.open()) {
            Jdbc.update(
                    c,
                    "UPDATE SONG_VIDEO SET match_status='PLAYABLE',checked_at=SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE"
                            + " song_id=? AND youtube_video_id=?",
                    songId,
                    id);
        }
    }

    public static String videoId(String url) {
        try {
            URI uri = URI.create(url);
            if (!"https".equals(uri.getScheme())
                    || !Set.of("www.youtube.com", "youtube.com", "m.youtube.com")
                            .contains(uri.getHost())
                    || !"/watch".equals(uri.getPath())) return null;
            for (String part : Optional.ofNullable(uri.getRawQuery()).orElse("").split("&"))
                if (part.matches("v=[A-Za-z0-9_-]{11}")) return part.substring(2);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }
        return null;
    }
}
```

## src/main/java/kr/ac/yumin/playlist/service/PlaylistService.java

```java
package kr.ac.yumin.playlist.service;

import kr.ac.yumin.playlist.config.Database;
import kr.ac.yumin.playlist.dao.*;
import kr.ac.yumin.playlist.model.*;

import java.sql.*;
import java.util.*;

/** 로그인 회원마다 생성한다. 모든 쓰기 작업은 부모 PLAYLIST 행 잠금과 같은 연결을 사용한다. */
public final class PlaylistService {
    private final Member member;
    private final PlaylistDao playlists = new PlaylistDao();
    private final SongDao songs = new SongDao();

    public PlaylistService(Member member) {
        this.member = Objects.requireNonNull(member);
    }

    public Member member() {
        return member;
    }

    @FunctionalInterface
    private interface Work<T> {
        T run(Connection c) throws SQLException;
    }

    private <T> T transaction(Work<T> action) throws SQLException {
        try (Connection c = Database.open()) {
            c.setAutoCommit(false);
            try {
                T value = action.run(c);
                c.commit();
                return value;
            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException e) {
                try {
                    c.rollback();
                } catch (SQLException rollback) {
                    e.addSuppressed(rollback);
                }
                throw e;
            }
        }
    }

    private void owner(Connection c, long id) throws SQLException {
        if (!playlists.lockOwner(c, member.id(), id))
            throw new AppException("본인이 만든 플레이리스트만 변경할 수 있습니다.");
    }

    public List<Playlist> mine() throws SQLException {
        try (Connection c = Database.open()) {
            return playlists.mine(c, member.id());
        }
    }

    public List<Playlist> discover(String query) throws SQLException {
        String q = AuthService.text(query, "검색어", 150, false);
        try (Connection c = Database.open()) {
            return q.isEmpty()
                    ? playlists.allPublic(c, member.id())
                    : playlists.publicLists(c, member.id(), q);
        }
    }

    public List<Song> search(String query) throws SQLException {
        String q = AuthService.text(query, "검색어", 200, false);
        try (Connection c = Database.open()) {
            return songs.search(c, q);
        }
    }

    public List<Song> searchPlayable(String query) throws SQLException {
        String q = AuthService.text(query, "검색어", 200, false).toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        try (Connection c = Database.open()) {
            return new MediaDao()
                    .catalog(c).stream()
                            .map(MediaTrack::song)
                            .filter(
                                    song ->
                                            (song.title() + " " + song.artists())
                                                    .toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)
                                                    .contains(q))
                            .toList();
        }
    }

    public PlaylistDetail detail(long id) throws SQLException {
        try (Connection c = Database.open()) {
            // 두 SELECT가 동일 시점의 공개 여부와 수록곡을 보도록 읽기 전용 트랜잭션 사용.
            c.setAutoCommit(false);
            try {
                Jdbc.update(c, "SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY");
                Playlist p =
                        playlists
                                .visible(c, member.id(), id)
                                .orElseThrow(() -> new AppException("조회할 수 없는 플레이리스트입니다."));
                var list = songs.inPlaylist(c, member.id(), id);
                c.commit();
                return new PlaylistDetail(p, List.copyOf(list));
            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException e) {
                c.rollback();
                throw e;
            }
        }
    }

    public long create(String title, String description, boolean pub) throws SQLException {
        String t = AuthService.text(title, "제목", 150, true),
                d = AuthService.text(description, "설명", 1000, false);
        return transaction(c -> playlists.create(c, member.id(), t, d, pub));
    }

    public void edit(long id, String title, String description, boolean pub) throws SQLException {
        String t = AuthService.text(title, "제목", 150, true),
                d = AuthService.text(description, "설명", 1000, false);
        transaction(
                c -> {
                    owner(c, id);
                    playlists.edit(c, member.id(), id, t, d, pub);
                    return null;
                });
    }

    public void delete(long id) throws SQLException {
        transaction(
                c -> {
                    owner(c, id);
                    playlists.delete(c, member.id(), id);
                    return null;
                });
    }

    public void add(long id, long song) throws SQLException {
        transaction(
                c -> {
                    owner(c, id);
                    var list = songs.inPlaylist(c, member.id(), id);
                    if (list.stream().anyMatch(s -> s.id() == song))
                        throw new AppException("이미 추가한 곡입니다.");
                    int next = list.stream().mapToInt(Song::order).max().orElse(0) + 1;
                    if (next > 999999) throw new AppException("목록에 더 이상 곡을 추가할 수 없습니다.");
                    songs.add(c, member.id(), id, song, next);
                    return null;
                });
    }

    public void remove(long id, long song) throws SQLException {
        transaction(
                c -> {
                    owner(c, id);
                    if (songs.remove(c, member.id(), id, song) != 1)
                        throw new AppException("이미 제거된 곡입니다.");
                    var remaining = songs.inPlaylist(c, member.id(), id);
                    // 오름차순으로 빈 번호에 이동하므로 UNIQUE 위반 없이 1부터 정리된다.
                    for (int i = 0; i < remaining.size(); i++)
                        if (remaining.get(i).order() != i + 1)
                            songs.order(c, member.id(), id, remaining.get(i).id(), i + 1);
                    return null;
                });
    }

    public void move(long id, long song, int direction) throws SQLException {
        if (direction != 1 && direction != -1) throw new AppException("이동 방향이 올바르지 않습니다.");
        transaction(
                c -> {
                    owner(c, id);
                    var list = songs.inPlaylist(c, member.id(), id);
                    int index = -1;
                    for (int i = 0; i < list.size(); i++) if (list.get(i).id() == song) index = i;
                    if (index < 0) throw new AppException("목록에 없는 곡입니다.");
                    int other = index + direction;
                    if (other < 0 || other >= list.size()) return null;
                    Set<Integer> occupied = new HashSet<>();
                    for (Song s : list) occupied.add(s.order());
                    int temp = 1;
                    while (occupied.contains(temp) && temp <= 999999) temp++;
                    if (temp > 999999)
                        throw new AppException("순서를 바꿀 빈 번호가 없습니다. 곡 하나를 제거한 후 다시 시도해 주세요.");
                    Song a = list.get(index), b = list.get(other);
                    songs.order(c, member.id(), id, a.id(), temp);
                    songs.order(c, member.id(), id, b.id(), a.order());
                    songs.order(c, member.id(), id, a.id(), b.order());
                    return null;
                });
    }

    public void like(long id, boolean value) throws SQLException {
        transaction(
                c -> {
                    if (value && !playlists.lockPublic(c, id))
                        throw new AppException("공개 플레이리스트에만 좋아요를 누를 수 있습니다.");
                    playlists.like(c, member.id(), id, value);
                    return null;
                });
    }
}
```

## src/main/java/kr/ac/yumin/playlist/ui/AlbumArt.java

```java
package kr.ac.yumin.playlist.ui;

import kr.ac.yumin.playlist.model.MediaTrack;

import java.awt.*;
import java.awt.image.BufferedImage;
import java.net.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

import javax.imageio.ImageIO;
import javax.swing.*;

/** Album thumbnails load off the EDT; missing images use the app's own artwork. */
final class AlbumArt implements Icon {
    private static final Map<String, BufferedImage> CACHE = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private static final Set<String> PENDING = ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet();
    private static final ExecutorService FETCH =
            Executors.newFixedThreadPool(
                    3,
                    r -> {
                        Thread t = new Thread(r, "album-art");
                        t.setDaemon(true);
                        return t;
                    });
    private final MediaTrack track;
    private final int size;

    AlbumArt(MediaTrack track, int size) {
        this.track = track;
        this.size = size;
    }

    public int getIconWidth() {
        return size;
    }

    public int getIconHeight() {
        return size;
    }

    public void paintIcon(Component c, Graphics g, int x, int y) {
        String url = track.coverUrl();
        BufferedImage image = url == null ? null : CACHE.get(url);
        if (image != null) g.drawImage(image, x, y, size, size, null);
        else {
            new MusicArt(track.song().id(), size).paintIcon(c, g, x, y);
            if (url != null && PENDING.add(url))
                FETCH.submit(
                        () -> {
                            try {
                                URI uri = URI.create(url);
                                if (!"https".equals(uri.getScheme())
                                        || !"cdnimg.melon.co.kr".equals(uri.getHost())) return;
                                URLConnection connection = uri.toURL().openConnection();
                                connection.setConnectTimeout(6000);
                                connection.setReadTimeout(6000);
                                try (var input = connection.getInputStream()) {
                                    BufferedImage loaded = ImageIO.read(input);
                                    if (loaded != null) CACHE.put(url, loaded);
                                }
                            } catch (Exception ignored) {
                            } finally {
                                SwingUtilities.invokeLater(
                                        () -> {
                                            for (Window window : Window.getWindows()) {
                                                if (window.isDisplayable()) window.repaint();
                                            }
                                        });
                            }
                        });
        }
    }
}
```

## src/main/java/kr/ac/yumin/playlist/ui/AlbumDialog.java

```java
package kr.ac.yumin.playlist.ui;

import kr.ac.yumin.playlist.model.*;
import kr.ac.yumin.playlist.service.*;

import java.awt.*;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
import java.util.function.Consumer;

import javax.swing.*;

public final class AlbumDialog extends JDialog {
    private final MediaTrack track;
    private final FavoriteService favorites;
    private final Runnable changed;
    private final Consumer<MediaTrack> play;
    private final JPanel body = Ui.column();
    private final JButton star = Ui.quiet("☆ 즐겨찾기", this::toggleFavorite);
    private final JLabel status = Ui.muted("앨범 정보를 불러오고 있습니다.");
    private boolean favorite;

    public AlbumDialog(
            Window owner,
            MediaTrack track,
            Member member,
            Runnable changed,
            Consumer<MediaTrack> play) {
        super(owner, "앨범 정보 · " + track.song().album(), ModalityType.MODELESS);
        this.track = track;
        this.favorites = new FavoriteService(member);
        this.changed = changed;
        this.play = play;
        JPanel root = Ui.padded(26);
        JPanel header = new JPanel(new BorderLayout(24, 0));
        header.add(new JLabel(new AlbumArt(track, 170)), BorderLayout.WEST);
        JPanel words = Ui.column();
        words.add(Ui.muted("ALBUM"));
        words.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(10));
        words.add(wrapped(track.song().album(), 22, true));
        words.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(10));
        words.add(wrapped(track.song().artists(), 13, false));
        words.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(12));
        star.setToolTipText("이 곡을 즐겨찾기에 저장 / 해제");
        star.setEnabled(false);
        words.add(star);
        header.add(words, BorderLayout.CENTER);
        root.add(header, BorderLayout.NORTH);
        body.setBorder(BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(24, 0, 0, 0));
        body.add(status);
        root.add(Ui.scroll(body), BorderLayout.CENTER);
        root.add(
                Ui.row(
                        Ui.primary(
                                "재생",
                                () -> {
                                    dispose();
                                    play.accept(track);
                                }),
                        Ui.quiet("정보 새로고침", () -> load(true)),
                        Ui.quiet("닫기", this::dispose)),
                BorderLayout.SOUTH);
        setContentPane(root);
        setSize(780, 740);
        setMinimumSize(new Dimension(680, 600));
        setLocationRelativeTo(owner);
        SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> load(false));
    }

    private record Data(AlbumDetail detail, boolean favorite) {}

    private void load(boolean refresh) {
        status.setText("앨범 정보를 불러오고 있습니다.");
        Ui.work(
                this,
                () ->
                        new Data(
                                new AlbumService().load(track.song().id(), refresh),
                                favorites.ids().contains(track.song().id())),
                data -> {
                    favorite = data.favorite();
                    updateStar();
                    star.setEnabled(true);
                    render(data.detail());
                    changed.run();
                });
    }

    private void render(AlbumDetail detail) {
        body.removeAll();
        body.add(Ui.text("앨범 정보", 16, true));
        body.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(12));
        fact(
                "발매일",
                detail.releaseDate() == null
                        ? null
                        : detail.releaseDate().format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyy.MM.dd")));
        fact("앨범 유형", detail.type());
        fact("장르", detail.genre());
        fact("발매사", detail.distributor());
        fact("기획사", detail.agency());
        body.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(20));
        body.add(Ui.text("선택한 곡 · " + track.song().title(), 15, true));
        body.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(12));
        fact("작사", detail.people("작사"));
        fact("작곡", detail.people("작곡"));
        fact("편곡", detail.people("편곡"));
        body.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(18));
        body.add(Ui.text("이 보관함의 앨범 수록곡", 14, true));
        body.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(8));
        for (Song song : detail.songs()) body.add(wrapped("• " + song.title(), 12, false));
        body.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(18));
        body.add(
                Ui.muted(
                        "정보 출처: Melon · "
                                + detail.fetchedAt()
                                        .format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyy.MM.dd HH:mm"))));
        body.revalidate();
        body.repaint();
    }

    private void fact(String label, String value) {
        JPanel line = new JPanel(new BorderLayout(15, 0));
        line.setAlignmentX(Component.LEFT_ALIGNMENT);
        JLabel name = Ui.muted(label);
        name.setPreferredSize(new Dimension(78, 26));
        line.add(name, BorderLayout.WEST);
        line.add(
                wrapped(value == null || value.isBlank() ? "제공된 정보 없음" : value, 12, false),
                BorderLayout.CENTER);
        line.setMaximumSize(
                new Dimension(Integer.MAX_VALUE, Math.max(32, line.getPreferredSize().height + 8)));
        body.add(line);
    }

    private static JLabel wrapped(String text, int size, boolean bold) {
        String safe = Ui.safe(text).replace("&", "&amp;").replace("<", "&lt;").replace(">", "&gt;");
        JLabel label =
                Ui.text("<html><div style='width:390px'>" + safe + "</div></html>", size, bold);
        label.setAlignmentX(Component.LEFT_ALIGNMENT);
        return label;
    }

    private void toggleFavorite() {
        boolean next = !favorite;
        Ui.work(
                this,
                () -> {
                    favorites.set(track.song().id(), next);
                    return next;
                },
                saved -> {
                    favorite = saved;
                    updateStar();
                    changed.run();
                });
    }

    private void updateStar() {
        star.setText(favorite ? "★ 즐겨찾기 저장됨" : "☆ 즐겨찾기");
        star.setForeground(favorite ? new Color(177, 119, 6) : Ui.MUTED);
    }
}
```

## src/main/java/kr/ac/yumin/playlist/ui/DetailDialog.java

```java
package kr.ac.yumin.playlist.ui;

import kr.ac.yumin.playlist.model.*;
import kr.ac.yumin.playlist.service.*;

import java.awt.*;
import java.util.List;

import javax.swing.*;
import javax.swing.table.DefaultTableModel;

public final class DetailDialog extends JDialog {
    private final PlaylistService service;
    private final java.util.function.Consumer<Song> listen;
    private final long id;
    private final Runnable changed;
    private PlaylistDetail detail;
    private List<Song> searchResults = List.of();
    private final JLabel title = Ui.heading("플레이리스트 불러오는 중"), meta = new JLabel(" ");
    private final JTextArea description = new JTextArea(2, 30);
    private final DefaultTableModel model = Ui.model("순서", "곡 제목", "아티스트", "앨범", "장르", "재생시간");
    private final DefaultTableModel searchModel = Ui.model("곡 제목", "아티스트", "앨범", "장르", "재생시간");
    private final JTable table = Ui.table(model), searchTable = Ui.table(searchModel);
    private final JPanel manage = new JPanel(new BorderLayout(0, 8));
    private final JButton like = Ui.button("좋아요", this::like);
    private final JTextField query = new JTextField(25);

    public DetailDialog(Window owner, PlaylistService service, long id, Runnable changed) {
        this(owner, service, id, changed, song -> {});
    }

    public DetailDialog(
            Window owner,
            PlaylistService service,
            long id,
            Runnable changed,
            java.util.function.Consumer<Song> listen) {
        super(owner, "플레이리스트 상세", ModalityType.APPLICATION_MODAL);
        this.listen = listen;
        this.service = service;
        this.id = id;
        this.changed = changed;
        setDefaultCloseOperation(DISPOSE_ON_CLOSE);
        setSize(1100, 790);
        setMinimumSize(new Dimension(850, 620));
        JPanel root = new JPanel(new BorderLayout(0, 14));
        root.setBorder(BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(22, 26, 22, 26));
        JPanel heading = Ui.column();
        heading.add(title);
        heading.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(10));
        heading.add(meta);
        heading.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(10));
        description.setEditable(false);
        description.setFocusable(false);
        description.setLineWrap(true);
        description.setWrapStyleWord(true);
        heading.add(new JScrollPane(description));
        JPanel header = new JPanel(new BorderLayout(22, 0));
        header.add(new MusicArt(id, 115), BorderLayout.WEST);
        header.add(heading, BorderLayout.CENTER);
        root.add(header, BorderLayout.NORTH);
        JPanel contents = new JPanel(new BorderLayout(0, 8));
        contents.add(new JScrollPane(table), BorderLayout.CENTER);
        JPanel ownButtons =
                Ui.row(
                        Ui.button("선택 곡 제거", () -> modify(0)),
                        Ui.button("위로 이동", () -> modify(-1)),
                        Ui.button("아래로 이동", () -> modify(1)));
        manage.add(ownButtons, BorderLayout.NORTH);
        JPanel search = new JPanel(new BorderLayout(0, 8));
        search.add(
                Ui.row(
                        new JLabel("곡 제목 / 아티스트"),
                        query,
                        Ui.button("곡 검색", this::search),
                        Ui.button("선택 곡 추가", this::add)),
                BorderLayout.NORTH);
        JScrollPane results = new JScrollPane(searchTable);
        results.setPreferredSize(new Dimension(700, 175));
        search.add(results, BorderLayout.CENTER);
        manage.add(search, BorderLayout.CENTER);
        contents.add(manage, BorderLayout.SOUTH);
        root.add(contents, BorderLayout.CENTER);
        root.add(
                Ui.row(
                        Ui.primary(
                                "선택 곡 듣기",
                                () -> {
                                    int row = table.getSelectedRow();
                                    if (row >= 0 && detail != null) {
                                        dispose();
                                        listen.accept(detail.songs().get(row));
                                    }
                                }),
                        like,
                        Ui.button("새로고침", this::reload),
                        Ui.button("닫기", this::dispose)),
                BorderLayout.SOUTH);
        manage.setVisible(false);
        like.setEnabled(false);
        setContentPane(root);
        setLocationRelativeTo(owner);
        query.addActionListener(e -> search());
        SwingUtilities.invokeLater(this::reload);
    }

    public void reload() {
        Ui.work(
                this,
                () -> service.detail(id),
                data -> {
                    detail = data;
                    Playlist p = data.playlist();
                    title.setText(p.title());
                    meta.setText(
                            "작성자: "
                                    + p.nickname()
                                    + "    |    "
                                    + (p.isPublic() ? "공개" : "비공개")
                                    + "    |    좋아요 "
                                    + p.likes()
                                    + "개");
                    description.setText(Ui.safe(p.description()));
                    model.setRowCount(0);
                    for (Song s : data.songs())
                        model.addRow(
                                new Object[] {
                                    s.order(),
                                    s.title(),
                                    s.artists(),
                                    s.album(),
                                    s.genre(),
                                    s.duration()
                                });
                    boolean own = p.owner().equals(service.member().id());
                    manage.setVisible(own);
                    like.setEnabled(p.isPublic() || p.liked());
                    like.setText(p.liked() ? "좋아요 취소" : "좋아요");
                    revalidate();
                    if (own && searchResults.isEmpty()) search();
                });
    }

    private void search() {
        String q = query.getText();
        Ui.work(
                this,
                () -> service.searchPlayable(q),
                data -> {
                    searchResults = data;
                    searchModel.setRowCount(0);
                    for (Song s : data)
                        searchModel.addRow(
                                new Object[] {
                                    s.title(), s.artists(), s.album(), s.genre(), s.duration()
                                });
                });
    }

    private void add() {
        int row = searchTable.getSelectedRow();
        if (row < 0) {
            Ui.info(this, "추가할 검색 결과 곡을 선택해 주세요.");
            return;
        }
        long song = searchResults.get(searchTable.convertRowIndexToModel(row)).id();
        Ui.work(
                this,
                () -> {
                    service.add(id, song);
                    return true;
                },
                ok -> {
                    reload();
                    changed.run();
                });
    }

    private void modify(int direction) {
        int row = table.getSelectedRow();
        if (row < 0 || detail == null) {
            Ui.info(this, "수록 곡을 선택해 주세요.");
            return;
        }
        long song = detail.songs().get(table.convertRowIndexToModel(row)).id();
        Ui.work(
                this,
                () -> {
                    if (direction == 0) service.remove(id, song);
                    else service.move(id, song, direction);
                    return true;
                },
                ok -> {
                    reload();
                    changed.run();
                });
    }

    private void like() {
        if (detail == null) return;
        boolean value = !detail.playlist().liked();
        Ui.work(
                this,
                () -> {
                    service.like(id, value);
                    return true;
                },
                ok -> {
                    reload();
                    changed.run();
                });
    }
}
```

```java
package kr.ac.yumin.playlist.ui;

import kr.ac.yumin.playlist.audio.AudioPlayer;
import kr.ac.yumin.playlist.model.*;
import kr.ac.yumin.playlist.service.*;

import java.awt.*;
import java.awt.event.*;
import java.awt.geom.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.List;

import javax.swing.*;
import javax.swing.table.*;

/** 로그인 화면 없이 열리는 음악 앱. 목록·이용권·저장은 모두 Oracle 서비스에서 읽는다. */
public final class MainFrame extends JFrame {
    private Member member;
    private PlaylistService playlists;
    private MusicLibraryService library;
    private MembershipService membership;
    private List<MediaTrack> tracks = List.of(), shownTracks = List.of();
    private List<Playlist> mine = List.of(), shared = List.of();
    private PassStatus pass = PassStatus.free();
    private final AudioPlayer player = new AudioPlayer();
    private final JPanel content = new JPanel(new BorderLayout()), sidebar = Ui.column();
    private final JLabel connection = Ui.muted("보관함을 연결하는 중입니다."),
            sectionTitle = Ui.text("둘러보기", 15, true);
    private final JTextField search = new JTextField(23);
    private final Map<String, JButton> navigation = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private final JLabel nowTitle = Ui.text("음악을 선택해 주세요", 13, true),
            nowArtist = Ui.muted("좋아하는 곡을 찾아 들어보세요"),
            time = Ui.muted("0:00 / 0:00"),
            playMode = Ui.muted("무료 · 1분 미리듣기");
    private final JLabel nowArt = new JLabel(new MusicArt(0, 48));
    private final JButton playButton, planButton;
    private final JSlider progress = new JSlider(0, 60, 0);
    private final javax.swing.Timer clock;
    private String page = "홈", filter = "전체";
    private boolean loading, updatingSlider, limitAnnounced;
    private MediaTrack selected;
    private OnlineVideoPanel onlinePlayer;
    private boolean onlineMode;
    private Set<Long> favoriteIds = Set.of();
    private Map<Long, String> videoStates = Map.of();
    private final JButton favoriteButton = Ui.quiet("☆", () -> toggleFavorite(footerTrack()));

    public MainFrame() {
        this(null);
    }

    public MainFrame(Member initialMember) {
        super("muse · 음악 플레이리스트");
        member = initialMember;
        setDefaultCloseOperation(DISPOSE_ON_CLOSE);
        setSize(1280, 900);
        setMinimumSize(new Dimension(1060, 740));
        JPanel root = new JPanel(new BorderLayout());
        root.add(buildSidebar(), BorderLayout.WEST);
        JPanel main = new JPanel(new BorderLayout());
        main.add(buildHeader(), BorderLayout.NORTH);
        main.add(content, BorderLayout.CENTER);
        root.add(main, BorderLayout.CENTER);
        playButton =
                iconButton(
                        "play",
                        24,
                        Ui.ACCENT,
                        () -> {
                            if (onlineMode
                                    && onlinePlayer != null
                                    && selected != null
                                    && onlinePlayer.link() != null
                                    && onlinePlayer.link().songId() == selected.song().id()) {
                                if (!page.equals("지금 재생 중")) navigate("지금 재생 중");
                                onlinePlayer.togglePause();
                            } else if (player.playing()) {
                                player.togglePause();
                            } else if (selected != null) play(selected);
                        });
        planButton = Ui.primary("Plus 이용권", this::openMembership);
        root.add(buildPlayer(), BorderLayout.SOUTH);
        setContentPane(root);
        setLocationRelativeTo(null);
        search.putClientProperty("JTextField.placeholderText", "곡, 가수, 앨범 검색");
        search.putClientProperty("JTextField.leadingIcon", new MuseIcon("search", 16, Ui.MUTED));
        search.addActionListener(
                e -> {
                    page = "전체 곡";
                    render();
                });
        clock = new javax.swing.Timer(200, e -> tick());
        clock.start();
        addWindowListener(
                new WindowAdapter() {
                    @Override
                    public void windowClosed(WindowEvent e) {
                        clock.stop();
                        player.close();
                        if (onlinePlayer != null) onlinePlayer.close();
                    }
                });
        render();
        SwingUtilities.invokeLater(this::refresh);
    }

        sidebar.setBorder(BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(30, 18, 22, 18));
        JLabel logo = Ui.text("muse.", 36, true);
        logo.setForeground(Ui.ACCENT);
        logo.setBorder(BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(0, 12, 28, 0));
        logo.setAlignmentX(Component.LEFT_ALIGNMENT);
        sidebar.add(logo);
        JLabel tag = Ui.muted("나의 일상에, 음악");
        tag.setBorder(BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(0, 13, 20, 0));
        sidebar.add(tag);
        String[][] items = {
            {"홈", "home"},
            {"전체 곡", "music"},
            {"지금 재생 중", "play"},
            {"즐겨찾기 곡", "star"},
            {"내 플레이리스트", "library"},
            {"공개 플레이리스트", "search"}
        };
```
